purpose: Execute one exact prepared .scscript once in an authorized clean SpaceClaim design and record the earliest success or failure state.
trigger: A hash-bound .scscript, matching build contract, current desktop authorization, clean-design entry policy, and run-owned output paths are available.

inputs.name: scscript_artifact
inputs.description: The exact formal artifact to load and run.

inputs.name: build_contract
inputs.description: Target environment, entry state, expected outputs, checkpoints, and safe-stop rules.

inputs.name: desktop_authorization
inputs.description: Permission to control the user's SpaceClaim session for this run.

preconditions: SpaceClaim is in the declared target environment, its window is maximized, and no blocking dialog is present.
The active document is a new unsaved design with no bodies because no baseline model was supplied.
The exact .scscript digest is recorded and its run-owned outputs do not exist.
The user has authorized desktop control for this run.

outputs.name: execution_contract
outputs.description: Observed entry state, exact artifact identity, stage events, outputs, failure state, recovery actions, and save state.

outputs.name: runtime_report
outputs.description: The report emitted by the exact script when available; it remains declared runtime data until independently checked.

outputs.name: model_artifact
outputs.description: The saved model path and digest only when the script reaches its save checkpoint.

postconditions: The exact artifact is run no more than once in the observed clean entry state.
Success records the exact output identities and stage result; failure records the earliest incorrect state.
A critical assertion failure does not produce an accepted saved model.
Uncertain completion or partial geometry requires a safe stop and clean rerun rather than another Run click.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim desktop session matching the build contract; keep the active window maximized during operation.
implementation.notes: The controller sequence is defined by the linked execution workflow; no standalone controller implementation is published in this candidate.

ambiguity_checks: Confirm the application, document, script identity, blocking-dialog state, and output ownership before the single Run action.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: The executed script, not the controller, owns geometry re-enumeration after creation.

failure_modes.condition: The active document is not the required clean design.
failure_modes.detection: Observe document identity and absence of bodies before loading the script.

failure_modes.condition: The formal script cannot be loaded or reports an immediate runtime error.
failure_modes.detection: Capture the exact dialog, console, or script error before any retry.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop without accepting or saving partial geometry.

failure_modes.condition: The controller cannot determine whether the script is still running or has finished.
failure_modes.detection: No final report, error, or stable post-run state is observable.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not press Run again; preserve the current state for diagnosis.

failure_modes.condition: The script finishes without the required report or native model checkpoint.
failure_modes.detection: Compare run-owned outputs with the build contract.
failure_modes.safe_state: Mark the run failed and do not infer success from visible geometry alone.

recovery.action: Create the required new design, then repeat the entry gate before loading the script.
Record the error, remove only run-owned failed outputs, repair the responsible upstream artifact, and restart from a new design.
Wait for a meaningful completion signal or diagnose the current run; never issue a second Run action to probe state.
Classify the earliest missing checkpoint, repair that stage, and rerun from a new design.

validation.method: Review the candidate against the clean-design workflow and recovery contract.
validation.expected: The entry gate, single-run rule, earliest-failure capture, safe stop, and clean rerun are explicit.

validation.method: Observe a controlled SpaceClaim run and bind the result to the .scscript SHA-256.
validation.expected: The exact artifact runs once and produces the declared terminal state.

evidence_level.notes: This operation accepts any exact prepared .scscript that satisfies its build contract. Composition-case runtime evidence is not inherited; reusable controller runtime layers remain not_tested.
